itens.titulo: Marvell Jumps 6% as GF Securities Says Google Chip Delay Won’t Dent Its Position; Broadcom Rises 3%
itens.descricao: Marvell Jumps 6% as GF Securities Says Google Chip Delay Won’t Dent Its Position; Broadcom Rises 3% Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read - Marvell jumped 7% and Broadcom rose 3% after GF Securities said Google's TPU delay won't alter Marvell's medium- to long-term supply chain standing.
- SOXX outpaced QQQ 3% to 2% as Google's warrant to acquire up to 7% of Marvell shares signals a partnership extending well beyond one delayed chip.
Marvell Technology (NASDAQ:MRVL) stock is at $241.27, up 6% in afternoon trading.
Meanwhile, Broadcom (NASDAQ:AVGO) stock is up 3%, a smaller gain than the jump in Marvell shares.

That view carries weight because Marvell has described its key hyperscaler partner as "one of the largest adopters of custom silicon." Last quarter's results gave Marvell a solid footing heading into the Google headlines.
The chipmaker reported Q2 FY2027 revenue of $2.74 billion, up 36.5% year over year (YoY), along with non-GAAP earnings per share (EPS) of $0.94.
Marvell's Data Center segment generated $2.17 billion, up 46% YoY, and now accounts for 79% of revenue.
Management expects scale-out switching to more than double during fiscal 2027 and stated that its scale-up optics opportunity is accelerating faster than previously expected.

itens.titulo: Jensen Huang Declares NVIDIA Can Win “in the Absence of Any AI Labs”
itens.descricao: Jensen Huang Declares NVIDIA Can Win “in the Absence of Any AI Labs” Yahoo Finance
trechos: Key Takeaways - NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang said on the BG2 podcast that about a third of the business, classical computing with no AI labs involved, is growing 30% to 40% a year.
- Huang puts all frontier labs together at 25% to 30% of NVIDIA's compute, highlighting demand beyond those labs without establishing their share of revenue.
- The main risk is concentration: Steve Eisman points to a 10-Q line showing 70% of NVIDIA's accounts receivable come from five customers.
- NVIDIA trades at 17.7x forward earnings, near its three-year low and well below its 30.3x average.
Investors have been asking since the market started debating whether OpenAI's revenue is $70 billion or $50 billion.
15 episode of the BG2 podcast, CEO Jensen Huang answered by carving his business into thirds, starting with one that has nothing to do with AI labs: "I'm going to call it a third of our business.
And that business is growing, call it 30%, 40% per year.
In the absence of any AI labs, NVIDIA is not zero, we're quite a large company." Which is putting it mildly.

itens.titulo: What Is Nvidia (NVDA) Signaling With New AI Chip And Space Computing Deals?
itens.descricao: What Is Nvidia (NVDA) Signaling With New AI Chip And Space Computing Deals? Yahoo Finance
trechos: - NVIDIA (NasdaqGS:NVDA) is working with Samsung and TSMC on next generation HBM chips built on TSMC's 3nm process.
- Samsung plans to use TSMC's 3nm node specifically for HBM, with NVIDIA co designing the base die for AI workloads.
We have also flagged 2 warning signs (1 major) for NVIDIA.
These moves around next generation AI infrastructure point to a wider theme in computing that many investors may want to explore through 55 AI infrastructure stocks.

Co designing HBM base dies around TSMC's 3nm process ties directly to the revenue per gigawatt catalyst, because memory bandwidth and power efficiency are core to those US$25b to US$40b per gigawatt system figures in the Narrative.
The SpaceX partnership adds another proof point for the "physical AI and autonomous systems" workload theme without removing the big risk that some large customers still want their own accelerators.
See how these catalysts shape NVIDIA's path to a $329 fair value.

itens.titulo: Intel Stock Climbs as JPMorgan Ends Bearish Call Held Since 2022
itens.descricao: Intel Stock Climbs as JPMorgan Ends Bearish Call Held Since 2022 Yahoo Finance
trechos: JPMorgan upgraded Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) to Neutral from Underweight with an $85 price target, ending a bearish call it had held since November 2022.
Intel shares rose 4.64% in premarket.
GuruFocus has detected 4 Warning Signs with INTC.
The firm's 2028 earnings estimate is about 15% above consensus.
It noted the stock has pulled back 36% from its June peak, compared with a 20% to 25% decline for the semiconductor group.
Since its initial downgrade, Intel's server x86 CPU share has fallen from 77% to 53%, and its PC CPU share from 81% to 68%.

It added that Intel's external foundry business barely reached $1 billion in annualized revenue in the first half of 2026, against about $150 billion for Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (NYSE:TSM).
